ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Direct Syscall of NtOpenProcess
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential calls to NtOpenProcess directly from NTDLL. Note: Unmapped fields: CallTrace, TargetImage, SourceImage, Provider_Name, GrantedAccess

sequences.query: CallTrace = RGX("^UNKNOWN") AND  NOT ((TargetImage = RGX("vcredist\\_x64\\\.exe$") AND SourceImage = RGX("vcredist\\_x64\\\.exe$")) OR ((SourceImage = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\.*") OR SourceImage = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\.*") OR SourceImage = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\.*") OR SourceImage = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\.*") OR SourceImage = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\WinSxS\\\\.*")) AND (TargetImage = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\.*") OR TargetImage = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\.*") OR TargetImage = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\.*") OR TargetImage = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\.*") OR TargetImage = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\WinSxS\\\\.*"))) OR Provider_Name = "Microsoft\-Windows\-Kernel\-Audit\-API\-Calls") AND  NOT ((TargetImage = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\system32\\\\systeminfo\\\.exe$") AND SourceImage = RGX("setup64\\\.exe$")) OR (SourceImage = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Explorer\\\.EXE$") AND TargetImage = RGX("\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Cylance\\\\Desktop\\\\CylanceUI\\\.exe$")) OR (SourceImage = RGX("AmazonSSMAgentSetup\\\.exe$") AND TargetImage = RGX("AmazonSSMAgentSetup\\\.exe$")) OR (SourceImage = RGX("\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Programs\\\\Microsoft\\ VS\\ Code\\\\Code\\\.exe$") AND TargetImage = RGX("\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Programs\\\\Microsoft\\ VS\\ Code\\\\Code\\\.exe$")) OR (TargetImage = RGX("\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Microsoft\\\\Teams\\\\current\\\\Teams\\\.exe$") AND SourceImage = RGX("\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Microsoft\\\\Teams\\\\current\\\\Teams\\\.exe$")) OR (TargetImage = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Discord\\\\.*") AND TargetImage = RGX("\\\\Discord\\\.exe$")) OR (SourceImage = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\yammerdesktop\\\\app\\-.*") AND SourceImage = RGX("\\\\Yammer\\\.exe$") AND TargetImage = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\yammerdesktop\\\\app\\-.*") AND TargetImage = RGX("\\\\Yammer\\\.exe$") AND GrantedAccess = "0x1000") OR TargetImage = RGX("\\\\Evernote\\\\Evernote\\\.exe$") OR (SourceImage = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Adobe\\\\Acrobat\\ DC\\\\Acrobat\\\\.*") AND SourceImage = RGX("\\\\AcroCEF\\\.exe$") AND TargetImage = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Adobe\\\\Acrobat\\ DC\\\\Acrobat\\\\.*") AND TargetImage = RGX("\\\\AcroCEF\\\.exe$")))
